new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9d38bf8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/chain_argument_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Group
+from .exceptions import NoArgsIsHelpError
+
+
+class ChainArgumentPreview(Group):
+    """A :class:`~click.Group` that, when chained, keeps the remaining
+    arguments in :attr:`Context.args` as well as in the protected args,
+    so they can be previewed before subcommands are invoked.
+    """
+
+    def parse_args(self, ctx: Context, args: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        if not args and self.no_args_is_help and not ctx.resilient_parsing:
+            raise NoArgsIsHelpError(ctx)
+
+        rest = super(Group, self).parse_args(ctx, args)
+
+        if self.chain:
+            ctx._protected_args = rest
+            ctx.args = rest
+        elif rest:
+            ctx._protected_args, ctx.args = rest[:1], rest[1:]
+
+        return ctx.args
diff --git a/tests/test_chain_argument_preview.py b/tests/test_chain_argument_preview.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5c154c7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_chain_argument_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.chain_argument_preview import ChainArgumentPreview
+
+
+def test_chain_assigns_rest_to_args():
+    group = ChainArgumentPreview("cli", chain=True)
+    ctx = click.Context(group)
+    rv = group.parse_args(ctx, ["a", "b", "c"])
+    assert rv == ["a", "b", "c"]
+    assert ctx.args == ["a", "b", "c"]
+    assert ctx._protected_args == ["a", "b", "c"]
+
+
+def test_non_chain_unchanged():
+    group = ChainArgumentPreview("cli")
+    ctx = click.Context(group)
+    rv = group.parse_args(ctx, ["a", "b", "c"])
+    assert ctx._protected_args == ["a"]
+    assert ctx.args == rv == ["b", "c"]
+
+
+def test_no_args_is_help():
+    group = ChainArgumentPreview("cli", chain=True)
+    ctx = click.Context(group)
+    with pytest.raises(click.exceptions.NoArgsIsHelpError):
+        group.parse_args(ctx, [])
